welBody: Welcome back! Each week: the message, the workout sign-up, community updates, and last week photos.
motwBody: Wild Friday. Sun barely up. Riverwalk's calling. Climb count? 100 steps of pure Tampa energy. DJ spinning tracks, keeping us moving. Take a moment—feel the sweat, hear the beats, see the colors. We're here together. Let's make it count.
cuBody: We're rolling out a new way to recognize the people who show up every week. Details soon — but starting now, make sure you check in at each workout so your climbs are on the record.
motwSub: Pause, breathe, and soak in the sunrise vibes
